grade: Original source colours; no creative grade. Existing HDR-to-SDR technical conversions retained.
headline_rule: White Playfair Display semibold. So/pick/one share a centred left stack with measured line gaps; supporting dream/chapter/life lines share the dream centre.
caption_placement: Stable baseline at967px and fixed left/center/right anchors143/960/1760. Phrase anchors stay fixed during word reveals.
chapter_support_placement: Existing lower-right heading fragments, now white Playfair Display.
caption_shadow: No outline. Soft black shadow alpha55, offset1.5px and blur1.5px at1080p.
headline_layer: All enlarged heading text behind the foreground subject matte.
body_font: Helvetica Neue Medium, TTC face index 10 on the reference Mac
music: Use the locally retained opening and brighter stems when reproducing the saved edit. For new speech, keep voice dominant and retime the transition to the turning point.

audio.note: The RMS ratio is a measured reference balance, not a volume-slider percentage. Do not apply it blindly to different stems.

broll.timing: Anchor card entrances to spoken words, preserving approved slots and sizes.
